title: The Effect of Platelet Rich Plasma on Lateral Epicondylitis
brief_summary: The purpose of this study is to compare the effects of platelet rich plasma, whole blood and saline vehicle on the natural course of lateral epicondylitis.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* The duration of symptoms over 3 months
* Primary conservative treatment (physiotherapy, NSAID, ...) has been tried

Exclusion Criteria:

* Significant systemic diseases
* Any surgical operation of the particular elbow
